experiment_data.hypothesis: Floor ratio ablation: raising the MLP floor to 0.6 significantly limits pruning freedom (minimum 60% of each layer kept). If accuracy plateaus between 0.5→0.6, it identifies the saturation point of floor parameter. If still improving, suggests the 0.4 default is suboptimal for CKA-only pruning.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/recovery_aware_struct_prune && HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 bash scripts/run_floor_ablation.sh 0.6 2"
